INSTRUMENT LANE (INSTRUMENT_LANE_V1) — Marco's ruling 2026-10-03.

Station 00 may merge a PR without Marco's involvement only when ALL of the following hold:
  1. Every changed file in the PR is in the `files` list or matches a `tests` glob.
  2. The `instrument-lane.json` file itself is UNCHANGED — changing the allowlist always needs Marco.
  3. CI is green.
  4. A fresh MERGE verdict exists for the exact current head SHA.
  5. The PR carries no `do-not-merge` label.

NEVER-LIST — these are explicitly out of scope and always require Marco:
  - `pipeline-lib.ps1` — the core library all scripts depend on
  - `arm-prompt.ps1` — the arming mechanism itself
  - `new-worktree.ps1` — worktree management
  - `retire-escalation.mjs` — escalation lifecycle
  - `dispatch.mjs` — the dispatcher
  - Everything under `scripts/pr-watcher/` — the watcher itself
  - Everything under `scripts/pr-gates/` — gate evaluation
  - Everything under `.github/` — CI workflows
  - Everything under `docs/` — documentation including DOCTRINE and station instructions
  - Everything under `sot/` — source of truth
  - Everything under `apps/` — application code
  - Everything under `prisma/` — database schema and migrations
  - `instrument-lane.json` itself — changing the allowlist is always Marco's decision

This file itself is NOT in the lane. Any change to `instrument-lane.json` immediately places the PR out of the instrument lane and routes it to Marco.
